messages.label: typed RPC {v, type, id, payload}
messages.note: the worker classifies the sender (id → origin/tab), checks the message permission table, then parses the payload schema — a rejected message answers a typed FORBIDDEN, never a silent undefined

messages.label: FORBIDDEN · type not allowed for this sender

cards.title: The gate is not optional
items: sender.id first, then the origin, then the frame, then the message permission table, then the payload schema — in that order, on every message
a content script gets a small subset; a session, policy or settings type is never in it, and the worker re-validates anyway
onMessageExternal uses an exact origin allowlist; a rejected message returns a typed FORBIDDEN, never a silent undefined

cards.title: The token never travels
items: the access token is read from chrome.storage.session by the worker and attached by the SDK; no UI surface ever holds it
the response to the UI carries data, never a token — the page, a content script and a log never see one
chrome.storage.local, chrome.storage.sync and IndexedDB are not encrypted at rest, so a secret never goes there

cards.title: The worker may be asleep
items: the RPC wakes the worker; the first render of a surface shows a loading state, then the data
a long-lived runtime.connect port dies with the worker: the client reconnects with backoff and resumes from a cursor
the correlation id follows the request into the logs and the API, so a failure can be traced across the boundary
